description: This Java abstract class manages activity states, reporting, and expiration logic for entities identified by keys, utilizing scheduling and concurrency features.

classes.name: AbstractActivityManager
classes.description: An abstract class that manages activity states, reporting, and expiration for entities, parameterized by Key and Metadata types.

classes.name: ActivityStateWrapper
classes.description: Inner class encapsulating activity state, last reported time, and strategy, with volatile fields for thread safety.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the scheduler to run periodic reporting at fixed intervals.

methods.name: getReportingPeriodMillis
methods.description: Abstract method to get the reporting period in milliseconds.

methods.name: getStrategy
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the current activity strategy.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Abstract method to update the activity state for a given key.

methods.name: hasExpired
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if a last recorded time has expired.

methods.name: onStateExpiry
methods.description: Abstract method called when a state expires.

methods.name: reportActivity
methods.description: Abstract method to report activity for a key with associated metadata.

methods.name: onActivity
methods.description: Handles incoming activity events, updates state, and triggers reporting if needed.

methods.name: onReportingPeriodEnd
methods.description: Handles end of reporting period, reporting last events for all tracked keys.

methods.name: reportLastEvent
methods.description: Reports the last activity event for a specific key, handling expiration and state updates.

methods.name: getLastRecordedTime
methods.description: Retrieves the last recorded time for a given key.

methods.name: updateLastReportedTime
methods.description: Updates the last reported time for a key, ensuring it is the maximum of current and new times.
